issue.title: test_busy_cluster_compacts_narrow_and_restores_wide flakes in parallel check
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-19f.6.1 note #1 while implementing queue multiplier projection. This ACE top-bar test failed in a full parallel just check lane and then passed serially and in a small -n 4 run on the unchanged tree. Investigate the failure under the wide lane, capture the assertion and load conditions, and fix the test or underlying timing behavior. No failure count beyond one fail/one rerun pass was recorded.

task_type_fields.evidence: Phase sase-19f.6.1 note #1: one failure during full parallel load, followed by serial and -n 4 passes on the unchanged tree; observed rate one failure in the recorded run, with no repeated sample.
